cause.root_cause_summary: S4's search checked only the ORIGINAL classification source (PHASE-966), not the later phases that re-applied the same rule to a new case (PHASE-967/968) -- a search scoped to 'where the rule was first defined' misses 'where the rule was later re-applied'.

lesson: When a rule is defined once and re-applied later to a new case, structured evidence of that re-application can live in a different phase's output than the rule's original definition -- searching only the origin point of a rule, not its later real applications, is a narrower search than it looks.
